Section 3 - Coverage
3.1 In-patient hospitalisation. The Company will pay medical expenses for hospitalisation of at least 24 consecutive
hours, subject to the limits in the Schedule of benefits.
3.2 Day care treatment. Day care procedures listed in Annexure I are covered even when hospitalisation is less
than 24 hours.
3.3 Pre- and post-hospitalisation. Medical expenses incurred up to 30 days before admission and up to 60 days
after discharge are covered, if related to the same condition.
3.4 Proportionate deduction. If the insured person occupies a room category higher than the eligible room, all
associated medical expenses shall be payable in the proportion that the eligible room rent bears to the actual room
rent. This does not apply to pharmacy, implants, consumables and diagnostics.

Section 4 - Cost sharing
4.2 Co-payment. A co-payment of 10% applies to every claim for insured persons aged 61 years or above at entry.
4.3 Non-payable items. Items listed in Annexure II, such as gloves, masks, admission kits and documentation
charges, are not payable.

Section 5 - Waiting periods and sub-limits
5.1 Initial waiting period. Expenses related to any illness within the first 30 days from the first policy
commencement date are excluded, except for accidents.
5.2 Specified illness waiting period. Expenses for treatment of cataract, hernia, gallbladder stones and joint
replacement are covered after 24 months of continuous coverage.
5.3 Cataract sub-limit. Cataract surgery is limited to Rs. 40,000 per eye per policy year.
5.4 Pre-existing diseases. Pre-existing diseases are covered after 36 months of continuous coverage from the first
policy commencement date.

Section 6 - Claims
6.1 Planned hospitalisation must be intimated to the TPA at least 72 hours before admission. Emergency
hospitalisation must be intimated within 48 hours of admission.
6.2 For reimbursement claims, documents must be submitted within 30 days of discharge.

Annexure II - Non-payable items (extract)
Gloves, masks, admission kit, documentation charges, attendant charges, diet charges for attendants.
